subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- September 10, 2026
body:
**AcreetionOS Newsletter - September 10, 2026**

**Decade of Rustls: A Decade of Secure Networking**

We're excited to announce that Rustls, the cryptographic library used in AcreetionOS, has just celebrated its 10th anniversary! Developed by Emilio Pozzi, Rustls has become a cornerstone of secure networking in the Rust ecosystem. Our team has been using Rustls to ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and authenticity of our communication protocols. We're proud to be part of this community-driven effort to make the internet a safer place.

**Community News**

* Our community has been actively contributing to the development of AcreetionOS, and we're grateful for their dedication. If you're interested in joining the conversation, please visit our Discord server at [https://discord.gg/VHqQkJASw7](https://discord.gg/VHqQkJASw7).
* We're also excited to announce that our community has started a new project, AcreetionMediaWriter, which allows users to write AcreetionOS images to USB from any operating system. You can find more information on our wiki.

**Practical Tip**

Did you know that you can customize your AcreetionOS experience by creating a custom kernel configuration? You can do this by editing the `kernel.config` file in the `/etc` directory. This allows you to tweak various kernel settings to suit your needs. For example, you can enable or disable specific features, adjust the kernel's performance, or even add custom kernel modules. For more information, please refer to our wiki.

That's all for this week's newsletter. We hope you found this update informative and helpful. As always, we appreciate your continued support and enthusiasm for AcreetionOS.
